title: m5stack/esphome#3 [vl53l1x] Add support for the Unit ToF4M

execution.environment: macOS arm64; CPython 3.12.14; PR worktree installed editable (ESPHome 2026.11.0-dev); local Device Service cores3 profile, Unit ToF4M on port-a

checks.name: cherry-pick identity
checks.detail: 5 component files + 3 test fixtures byte-identical; differences vs current esphome/dev are later upstream refactors

checks.name: schema edge cases
checks.detail: non-0x29 without enable_pin, medium+15ms, 16x16 ROI center 150 and duplicate address rejected; two-sensor fixture accepted

checks.name: virtual device boot (unmodified PR firmware)
checks.command: cores3 session + tof4m on port-a, serial UART0
checks.detail: boot to setup() finished; I2C scan finds 0x29; component marks FAILED 'Boot timeout' because the model lacks 0x00E5

checks.name: virtual device data plane (model gaps bridged)
checks.command: probe firmware: seed 0x00E5=1 on boot, retrigger 0x0087=0x40 every 100ms
checks.detail: 12x DIST_MM=1000 then 29x DIST_MM=2500 after unit-input; unit side range-status 9, timing-budget 50, clear-writes 83

checks.name: physical ToF4M
checks.detail: no physical unit; range/optics/laser safety and PaHub path not exercised

model_gaps: virtual VL53L1X does not implement FIRMWARE__SYSTEM_STATUS (0x00E5); boot poll always reads 0
SYSTEM_MODE_START (0x0087) only handles 0x40/0x00; single-shot 0x10 is ignored, and the default-config write clears vl_ready
timing-budget writes 0x005E/0x0061 are observation-only; timing-budget-ms stays at 50
notes: Review only: PR left open, no push to the PR branch, one English comment.
Virtual-device data-plane result is only reachable with two explicit bus-level workarounds; it is not a model-native PASS and not hardware.
No blocking defect found; the remaining ask is the exact YAML and a serial log for the 'tested on CoreS3 through a PaHub' claim.
Session IDs are redacted to short hashes in evidence; raw serial text is unmodified.
